svg.aria-label: Work flow of one part: Setup 1
svg.text: Work flow of one part: Setup 1
Each box: who acts, what happens, and the signal that confirms the step before the next one starts.

g.text: OPERATOR
Load the input pallet, press "Pallet loaded"
confirm: CP-1 PX-11 + CAM-1 pallet present
CAMERA 1
Locate the next raw part (x, y, angle)
confirm: part found → pick pose to Robot 1
ROBOT 1
Pick the raw part from the pallet
confirm: GR-21 grip OK · CAM-1 slot empty
ROBOT 1 + CNC
Open the CNC door (the robot slides it)
needs CNC stopped, ZS-33 unlocked → ZS-31 open
ROBOT 1 + CNC
Load the part in the vise and clamp
confirm: ZS-35 clamped · PS-36 seated · R1 clear
ROBOT 1 + CNC
Close the CNC door
confirm: ZS-32 closed · ZS-33 locked
CNC
Cycle start → machining (2 min)
confirm: in cycle → cycle complete, spindle stop
ROBOT 1 + CNC
Open the door and unload the part
confirm: ZS-31 · ZS-34 open · PS-36 OFF · GR-21
ROBOT 1
Place the part at the conveyor entry
needs ENC-43 = 0 · confirm: CP-2 PE-41 + CAM-1
CONVEYOR
Transport to the end stop
confirm: ENC-43 moving · stop on PE-42 · = 0
CAMERA 2
Verify the part and locate it
confirm: CP-3 PE-42 + CAM-2 · pick pose
ROBOT 2
Pick the part from the conveyor
confirm: GR-51 grip OK · CP-3 exit clear
ROBOT 2
Place the part on the output pallet
confirm: CP-4 PX-52 + CAM-2 · slot occupied
Output pallet
full (12 parts)?
LIGHT + OPERATOR
LT-53 blue light ON: pallet ready for pickup
operator swaps it → PX-52 OFF → ON · count = 0

svg.text: CP-n = the camera and the proximity sensor must
agree. If they disagree the camera value is used
and the mismatch is logged; 3 mismatches within
10 min stop the line for sensor verification.
